en: Black-and-white vintage postcard view of a rural scene with a dirt road and a railway line curving into a small town. In the background stands a large church with a prominent tower rising above the surrounding low buildings and fields. Several trees line the dirt road, and railway signals and a small rail car are visible along the tracks. The printed caption in the upper left reads "Herzberg (Elster)".
